measurement_convention.rock_scale: Actual image cell width / S=2m, M=4m, L=8m. Equal scale in all views. No per-view fitting.
measurement_convention.rock_dimensions: front bbox width, top bbox height (depth), front bbox height including small contact trim; actual body extent, not requested target dimensions.
measurement_convention.rock_consistency_percent: absolute difference divided by the mean of the pair, times 100
measurement_convention.cliff_scale: Actual image width / 24m, ground at 704/768 of actual height. Edges are first/last image columns.
measurement_convention.cliff_middle: 84% of image width between the 8% edge bands; empty exit columns have zero height.
measurement_convention.luminance: Rec.709 weighted RGB values on 0–255 encoded channels; population standard deviation on alpha>=128 body pixels.
measurement_convention.alpha_note: A thresholded silhouette can pass while low-alpha noise fails exact transparent-background rules. Both are reported.

production_acceptance: pending; not all requested numeric constraints pass
